description_en: Queries the remediation records of a rule in an account group
description_zh: 查询指定账号组内规则的修正执行记录
kebab_example: aliyun config list-aggregate-remediation-executions --config-rule-id cr-2792626622af0c210000 --next-token aVCjqFaSy0Ps6zSMGw090000 --max-results 10 --execution-status Success --resource-account-id 1266720040880000 --aggregator-id ca-edd3626622af00b30000 --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAggregateRemediationExecutions

parameters.help_en:
The rule ID.

For more information about how to obtain the ID of a rule, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/264148.html
parameters.help_zh:
规则ID。

关于如何获取规则ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/264148.html
parameters.name: config_rule_id

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request. You must specify the token that is obtained from the previous query as the value of NextToken
parameters.help_zh: 当请求的返回结果被截断时，您可以使用NextToken再次发起请求，获取从当前截断位置之后的内容
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return for a single request. Valid values: 10 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 单次请求返回结果的最大条数。取值范围：10~100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The status of the remediation. Valid values:

*   Success
*   Failed
parameters.help_zh:
修正执行状态，取值：

- Success：成功。

- Failed：失败
parameters.name: execution_status

parameters.help_en: The ID of the member account in the account group. When left unfilled, this rule queries the remediation result for the account that created the rule. If the account is not in the account group, the result will be empty
parameters.help_zh: 账号组内成员账号ID。不填写时查询该规则创建账号的修正结果，若此账号不在账号组内时，返回结果为空
parameters.name: resource_account_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the account group.

For more information about how to obtain the ID of an account group, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.help_zh:
账号组ID。

关于如何获取账号组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.name: aggregator_id
